start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-h.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=Asia/Kolkata APP_ENV=dev && rm -f eval-h.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-h-server.log 2>&1
start_note: Backend :8000 and Vite :5173 (proxies /api to 127.0.0.1:8000). Setup as in group G (sqlite3 admin insert with argon2 hash, POST /api/admin/doctors for doctors A and B with several slots each, register patients P1..P2, book via POST /api/appointments). PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=Asia/Kolkata so the queue day-boundary check (F074) is meaningful. Time-dependent states (60:00 boundary, started slots, 14-day window, CHECKED_IN/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/NO_SHOW) are arranged by sqlite3 UPDATE of slots.start_time/end_time and appointments.status with safe margins. Exact 60:00 vs 59:59 boundary, injected-failure rollback (F070) and NO_SHOW-after-start via advanced clock are verified by the pytest tests (backend/tests/integration/test_reschedule.py, test_lifecycle.py, test_queue.py, concurrency/test_reschedule_race.py) using the injected clock; live checks use margins only. Admin UI checks (E5-S5) run against the live stack with seeded/created data; 422 and 409 UI states are produced by real API conditions where feasible (invalid slot_length, doctor with BOOKED appointment) or by Playwright route interception.

api_checks.note: setup/regression: GET /health 200; admin login; onboard doctors A and B; register patients P1, P2; book BOOKED appointments. Failure blocks the group.

P1 books slot X of doctor A (start > now+61m); reschedule to open slot Y of doctor A -> 200, same appointment_id, slot_id == Y, status BOOKED; sqlite3: slot Y BOOKED, slot X AVAILABLE; GET /api/appointments/{id} shows new start_time. Also verify exactly one appointment row exists for P1 (id unchanged, no new appointment).
after H-API-1, sqlite3 newest appointment_events row for the appointment is type RESCHEDULED with old_slot_id=X and new_slot_id=Y; exactly one RESCHEDULED event added.

six invalid targets, each -> 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: (a) slot already BOOKED by P2, (b) slot BLOCKED by doctor A, (c) slot already started (sqlite3 start in past), (d) slot beyond 14 days (sqlite3 start now+15d), (e) the appointment's current slot, (f) doctor B's slot. After each: appointment slot_id, both slots' statuses and event count unchanged. Nonexistent new_slot_id -> 404; missing/non-int body -> 422.

current slot start set via sqlite3 to now+59m -> 409 CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED, nothing changed (slots, slot_id, event count); start at now+62m -> 200 (document slack). Exact 59:59 (409) / 60:00 (200) boundary verified by pytest test_reschedule.py with injected clock; evaluator confirms that boundary test exists, is not skipped and passes.
appointments set via sqlite3 to CHECKED_IN, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW (start > now+2h): reschedule each -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE; no event added, slots unchanged.
no token -> 401; doctor token -> 403; admin token -> 403; P2 reschedules P1's appointment -> 404; nothing changed.

failure injection is not reachable over HTTP; run pytest backend/tests/integration/test_reschedule.py (injected failing event insert after target claim: non-2xx, slots and appointment unchanged) and concurrency/test_reschedule_race.py. Evaluator confirms the tests exist, are not skipped, and pass.
doctor A: BOOKED -> CHECKED_IN -> IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED via POST status; each 200 with the new status; sqlite3: event count +1 per call, each with actor_role DOCTOR.

BOOKED->IN_PROGRESS, BOOKED->COMPLETED, CHECKED_IN->CANCELLED, and any change from COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE; status and event count unchanged. Unknown status string -> 422. Also BOOKED->BOOKED (status BOOKED body) -> 409. pytest backend/tests/unit/test_state_machine.py must pass (full transition matrix).

NO_SHOW on a BOOKED appointment whose start is in the future -> 409; after sqlite3 moves start into the past: NO_SHOW from BOOKED -> 200 and slot stays BOOKED; repeat from CHECKED_IN -> 200 slot BOOKED.

with PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=Asia/Kolkata, doctor A has appointments at 23:30 IST on D and 00:30 IST on D+1 (sqlite3 slot times, i.e. 18:00Z D and 19:00Z D). GET queue?date=D contains only the 23:30 item; date=D+1 only the 00:30 item; items ordered ascending by start_time; other doctor's appointments absent; response has date, timezone, total; bad date -> 422; patient 403; admin 403; no token 401. Every item carries allowed_actions for DOCTOR (E3-S5 AC5); queue includes all statuses (CANCELLED/NO_SHOW items present) per API-15; default date (omitted) returns today in provider zone with 200.

doctor GET BOOKED appointment before start: allowed_actions contains CHECKED_IN and CANCEL, not NO_SHOW; after sqlite3 start moved to past: contains NO_SHOW; CHECKED_IN -> IN_PROGRESS (+ NO_SHOW after start); IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED; COMPLETED/CANCELLED/NO_SHOW -> []. Patient view of BOOKED far-future: [CANCEL, RESCHEDULE]; admin view always [].
doctor B POST status on doctor A's appointment -> 404; patient -> 403; admin -> 403; no token -> 401; status unchanged and no event in each case.

BOOKED appointment, doctor owner POST status CANCELLED -> 200 status CANCELLED; slot becomes BLOCKED (not AVAILABLE); exactly one event with actor_role DOCTOR. Contract-derived (api-contracts API-26); AC2 only covers CHECKED_IN->CANCELLED refusal.

BOOKED appointment whose current slot start was moved via sqlite3 into the past: reschedule to an open slot -> 409 CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED (api-contracts API-25/error table: 'or after start'); nothing changed.
pytest backend/tests/integration/test_lifecycle.py and test_queue.py run, are not skipped, and pass (injected-clock NO_SHOW, event-count assertions, queue day boundary).

steps: log in as the admin; reach the onboarding screen via in-app navigation (route path not fixed by spec)

F116: form has specialty, languages, fee inputs and a template-row editor; add two rows (weekday, start, end, slot length); submit valid data -> success view shows the new doctor (name/email, specialty); GET /api/doctors afterwards lists the doctor; (AC1) the fee is entered as a decimal string and shown unchanged

F117: submit a row with an invalid slot length (e.g. 09:00-10:00 with 25 min) or end before start -> the server 422 message renders next to that row's field; all previously entered values (email, specialty, languages, fee, all rows) remain
F118: open the user list; role filter set to Doctor shows only doctors, Patient only patients; inactive rows show Reactivate, active rows show Deactivate; the admin's own row has Deactivate disabled
F118: deactivate then reactivate a patient via the UI; row label/status toggles; GET /api/admin/users agrees
F119: Deactivate a doctor who has a BOOKED appointment -> message stating the doctor has active appointments is displayed; the row still shows Deactivate / active status

F120: click Edit profile on a patient row; form opens prefilled; change full_name/age/gender/phone and save -> success message; list/profile reflects the change; invalid age (e.g. 0) shows a field error and no success message
no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) on onboarding and user list at 1280px (E5-S5 is designed 1280px-first)

content_rules: E3-S4: reschedule route guarded by require_roles(PATIENT); doctor/admin 403; non-owner and unknown new_slot_id 404; SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED, INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE map to 409; no SQL in the router

E3-S4: target claim is a conditional UPDATE (status AVAILABLE, window, same active doctor, different slot) requiring exactly 1 row; claim, old-slot release, appointments.slot_id repoint and RESCHEDULED event (old_slot_id/new_slot_id) occur in one transaction that rolls back on any failure; 60-minute check uses the injected clock with >= 60:00 allowed

E3-S5: transitions validated by types/state_machine.py (no transition logic duplicated in router or frontend); exactly one event with actor_role DOCTOR per valid transition and none on refusal; NO_SHOW requires now >= start_time via injected clock and leaves slot BOOKED; CANCELLED from BOOKED delegates to cancellation_service behaviour (slot BLOCKED, refund once)

E3-S5: queue day window computed from PROVIDER_TIMEZONE [00:00, 24:00) converted to UTC, ordered by start_time, caller's appointments only; /api/doctors/me/queue registered before /api/doctors/{doctor_id}

E3-S5: allowed_actions computed in service/allowed_actions.py per role and clock (PATIENT, DOCTOR, ADMIN matrix per api-contracts); only the appointment's doctor may transition (other doctor 404, patient/admin 403)

E5-S5: frontend calls the API only via src/api/admin.ts and hooks; routes.tsx replaces any ADMIN placeholder with OnboardDoctorPage and UserListPage; fee sent as a string (no parseFloat/toFixed on money)

E5-S5: 422 errors[].field paths (e.g. availability_templates[0].slot_length_minutes) are mapped to the matching template-row fields; form state is preserved on error; 409 ACTIVE_APPOINTMENTS_EXIST shown inline (no alert, no console.log); Deactivate disabled for the logged-in admin's own row

review_notes: Proposed by generator (lean); pending evaluator review. Derived from stories E3-S4, E3-S5, E5-S5, api-contracts API-09/15..20, 24..26, component-map and features.json (F065-F076, F116-F120).
Story E3-S4 AC3 says 409 for all invalid targets; api-contracts API-25 specifies code SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, and 404 for a nonexistent new_slot_id (checked separately in H-API-3).
Story E3-S5 AC2 names InvalidAppointmentStateException; the API contract error code is INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE.

Exact 60:00/59:59 boundary (F068), injected-failure rollback (F070) and clock-advanced NO_SHOW (F073) are not reliably HTTP-observable; backed by pytest with injected clock, live checks use sqlite3 margins.
F074 queue boundary is meaningful only with PROVIDER_TIMEZONE != UTC, so the start command sets Asia/Kolkata.

E5-S5 admin route paths are not fixed in the spec; evaluator should follow in-app navigation. E5-S5 UI feature steps mention a mocked API; live verification may use real API conditions or Playwright route interception.
Out of scope: doctor-side UI for the queue/lifecycle (E5-S4), patient reschedule UI (E5-S3), my-appointments (E4-S3 already done).

Evaluator review: removed 'no console errors' from PW step (no AC/contract basis) and the 'no new backend files' content rule (no AC basis). Added H-API-14 (API-26 CANCELLED via status -> slot BLOCKED), H-API-15 (reschedule after start -> CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED), H-API-16 (lifecycle/queue pytest), plus queue allowed_actions/all-status/default-date assertions, state-machine unit test, and 60:00 boundary test confirmation. All other checks trace to E3-S4 AC1-6, E3-S5 AC1-6, E5-S5 AC1-5 or api-contracts API-15/18/25/26.
